releaseNotes: Subtitles now find the right film or episode: the app was searching by title, which returned thousands of unrelated results or none at all for a Spanish name, and now asks by the title's own id. A second subtitle site, SubDL, has been added for wider coverage. Watched ticks now agree with your phone - finishing an episode here no longer removes it from your other devices, and both apps use the same watched rule. Hold a movie poster to mark it watched or unwatched. The app also re-syncs with the cloud whenever you come back to it, not just on a cold start. Update from Settings - Check for Updates.
